# Vendor preview engines

Offline copies used by the desktop preview pane.

| File | Version | License | Source |
|------|---------|---------|--------|
| `katex.min.js` / `katex.min.css` / `fonts/*.woff2` | 0.16.22 | MIT | [KaTeX](https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX) |
| `mermaid.min.js` | 11.4.1 | MIT | [Mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) |
| `codemirror.min.js` / markdown / xml / CSS | 5.65.18 | MIT | [CodeMirror](https://github.com/codemirror/codemirror5) |

HTML export loads the same versions from jsDelivr so standalone files stay small.
